title: How to Store Silver Without Losing It

segments.text: 65% of burglars were personally known to the victim.
A hiding spot is not protection.
segments.narration: Burglars spend 10 to 12 minutes inside a home. That's enough time to find the shoebox, check the closet, and be gone. Without a locked safe, you're just making them work slightly harder.
House fires regularly hit that range. The metal might survive. The plastic holders around it won't. A UL-rated fire safe keeps the interior below 350°F.

segments.text: Moisture doesn't kill value — but it matters.
segments.narration: Tarnish doesn't reduce melt value, but it damages collectible coins. Airtight containers and silica gel packs fix this completely.

segments.text: At $15,000, one theft = 25 years of vault fees.
segments.narration: A professional vault runs $5 to $20 a month. At a certain stack size, home storage stops making financial sense. That's when Fused Reserve is worth looking at.
